stem: You want a 3-qubit hardware-efficient variational ansatz whose gate set is nothing but `ry` rotations and `cx` entanglers, so that every amplitude it can prepare stays real. Which single circuit-library call builds it?
code:
from qiskit.circuit.library import (
    efficient_su2,
    excitation_preserving,
    pauli_two_design,
    quantum_volume,
    real_amplitudes,
    zz_feature_map,
)

options.text: `efficient_su2(3)` — the SU(2) ansatz, which layers an `ry` and an `rz` on each qubit
`zz_feature_map(3)` — the second-order data-encoding map built from `h` and `p` gates
`pauli_two_design(3, seed=7)` — randomly drawn `rx`/`ry`/`rz` layers with `cz` entanglers
`quantum_volume(3, seed=7)` — stacked layers of Haar-random two-qubit unitary blocks

explanation.correct: `real_amplitudes` is the RY-only member of the n-local family: it alternates a layer of `ry` rotations (one parameter per qubit) with a `cx` entanglement layer, and nothing else. Because RY and CX both have real matrices, every state it can prepare has real amplitudes — hence the name. Since Qiskit 2.1 the function form is the supported entry point; the `RealAmplitudes` class still works but is deprecated for removal in 3.0.

distractors.A: `efficient_su2` is the same skeleton with a *pair* of rotations per qubit — `ry` then `rz`. The `rz` layer makes amplitudes complex and doubles the parameter count, so its gate set is not RY+CX.
distractors.B: A feature map encodes classical data, it is not a variational ansatz: its parameters are the input features. `zz_feature_map` builds Hadamards and phase gates around its entanglers.
distractors.C: The Pauli two-design draws its rotation axes randomly from X, Y and Z, and it entangles with `cz`. Its amplitudes are not restricted to the reals.
distractors.D: `quantum_volume` is a benchmarking circuit of random two-qubit unitary blocks. It carries no free parameters at all, so there is nothing for an optimizer to vary.
distractors.F: The excitation-preserving ansatz conserves particle number using `rz` rotations and two-qubit interaction blocks; that structure is chosen for chemistry problems, not for a plain RY+CX ansatz.

provenance.notes: Circuit-library coverage gap from data/audits/official_alignment.md (task 1.2). Gate sets measured on qiskit 2.5.0.
